description: `false and (1 / 0)` short-circuits (spec/execution-model.md:141): `and` never evaluates its right operand once the left is `false`, so the `ol-div-zero` that operand would raise is never reached. Result is `false`. Issue #95. Issue #815: the operand was `:missing` until the check before execution landed, at which point an unbound read became a *statically* decided fault and this correct program stopped running at all. `1 / 0` keeps the subject and strengthens it — the skipped operand is one that would genuinely raise (`ol-div-zero`) if it were evaluated, and its absence from the diagnostics is the proof.
